VACANCY NOTICE
The Uttarakhand Electricity Regulatory Commission (UERC) invites application for
the following vacancies, which is to be filled up on Direct recruitment Basis:
Sr. Name of Posts Pay Level No. of Post
1 Assistant Director (Technical) Level 10 One (01)
3. Assistant Director (Tariff) Level 10 One (01)
4. Assistant Director (Law) Level 10 One (01)
Further details, application format and other instructions can be downloaded
from/seen at the Commission’s website www.uerc.uk.gov.in. Application in prescribed
format along with requisite documents are invited from eligible candidates through speed
post only latest by 07.12.2026.
Advt. No. – 18/2026-27 Secretary
